title: Policy Gap Analysis & Auto-Drafting
summary: Automated analysis of the organization's current policy library against a selected Framework (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) to identify coverage gaps and auto-draft missing policies.
goals: Reduce the barrier to entry for new frameworks.
Provide 'starter' content for missing policies to unblock teams.

user_stories.outcome: see a matrix of checks showing which required policies are missing.
receive an AI-generated policy tailored to the organization's industry and the specific requirement.

logic.mapping: Many-to-Many mapping between Framework Requirements and Policy Types.
logic.gap_detection: If Framework requires 'Access Control Policy' and Organization has none of type 'Access Control', flag as Gap.

acceptance_criteria: Visual dashboard showing % coverage of a Framework by Policies.
One-click generation of a draft policy for a detected gap.
Generated policy is saved as a draft in the content management system.
